title: Dead Tired
description: Grim attempts to rest in peace, but the underworld has other plans.

panels.alt: Grim in his purple bath robe collapses into a chair, exhausted.
panels.caption: At last... quiet.

panels.alt: The Plague Doctor appears at the doorway with dramatic urgency.
panels.caption: You are not going to believe this.

panels.alt: The neighborhood erupts into absurd supernatural commotion outside.
panels.caption: Rest in peace will have to wait.
